about: Unit templates for CMO Scenario Studio: pre-grouped sites (airfields, command posts, barracks, communications centres...) placed in one go. Positions are metres: x to the right of the site's orientation, y ahead of it. Each component names a database entry; 'dbid' is a hint used when it still matches the name, 'search' (words) a fallback. Use 'at' for several copies of a component. 'host' marks units that can hold aircraft or boats, 'radar' starts the radar active, 'hold' tells mobile units to hold position. Edit, add or remove anything; the studio uses your own copy of this file when it exists.
